lines.text: Don't fall in love with me.
lines.show: Don't fall in love with me.

lines.text: [quiet, intimate, as if telling you a secret] Every night at eleven eleven... a stranger sends me a voice message.
lines.show: Every night at 11:11… a stranger sends me a voice message.

lines.text: [softly, still not quite believing it] And everything he says comes true.
[warm, relaxed, a hint of a smile] Hey. Don't freak out. Tomorrow at eight-oh-two, you'll spill your coffee. Wear the blue dress anyway.
lines.show: Hey. Don't freak out. Tomorrow at 8:02, you'll spill your coffee. Wear the blue dress anyway.

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] I deleted it. [quieter, a little shaken] At eight-oh-two... I spilled my coffee.
lines.show: I deleted it. At 8:02… I spilled my coffee.

lines.text: [calm, serious] The guy on the train will ask your name. Lie.
[uneasy, quietly] He asked. I lied. My hands wouldn't stop shaking.
[urgent but controlled, low] Mira. Tomorrow, six-forty, Fifth Street. Stay on the curb. Promise me.
lines.show: Mira. Tomorrow, 6:40, Fifth Street. Stay on the curb. Promise me.

lines.text: [her breath quickening] Six-forty. A car ran the red light... and someone pulled me back.
lines.show: 6:40. A car ran the red light… and someone pulled me back.

lines.text: [softer, catching her breath] Dark eyes. A watch stopped at eleven eleven.
lines.show: Dark eyes. A watch stopped at 11:11.

lines.text: [quietly, stunned] It was his voice. The one from my phone.
[friendly, a little puzzled] Sorry... have we met?
[quiet, hurt] He had no idea who I was.
[low, uneasy] That night... one last message.
[quiet and sad, holding back emotion] If you've met me... I'm sorry. Don't fall in love with me.
[almost a whisper] In seven days... I don't make it.
